categories.main_business_segments: Teikoku Tsushin Kogyo (NOBLE) operates two main business segments: Electronic Components and Others. The Electronic Components segment includes the development, manufacturing, and sales of resistors (variable and fixed), sensors, switches, and front operation blocks (ICB). The Others segment covers sales of machinery, equipment, and environmentally friendly materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include proprietary element technology, molding and decorative techniques, and press technology, particularly for ICB products and sensors. They emphasize high-precision, high-durability resistive elements, advanced surface treatment, and flexible film technologies for curved sensors. Manufacturing is supported by both domestic and overseas plants, with ongoing automation and IoT integration in production lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global set manufacturers in the automotive, consumer electronics (AV equipment, home appliances), industrial equipment, medical and healthcare, and amusement device sectors. The company also targets emerging markets such as EVs, 5G communications, and infrastructure monitoring.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span Japan, China, Southeast Asia (notably Thailand and Vietnam), North America, and other Asian regions. Production and sales bases are located in Japan, China, Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore, Hong Kong, and the US, with sales distributed globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Teikoku Tsushin Kogyo operates primarily as a midstream supplier, manufacturing and supplying electronic components and modules to OEMs and set manufacturers, who then integrate these into end products for various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding existing domains (especially in energy-saving, EV, and healthcare), developing new products aligned with customer needs (e.g., non-contact switches, advanced sensors), and entering new fields such as 5G, disaster prevention, and infrastructure. R&D focuses on high-precision element technology, bio-sensors for POCT, and sustainable materials, with active collaboration with universities and external partners.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of electronic components and modules to B2B customers. Additional revenue streams include sales of machinery, equipment, and environmentally friendly materials. Revenue is recognized at the point of shipment to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: NOBLE competes with both domestic and international electronic component manufacturers. While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a technology-driven, quality-focused supplier with a strong reputation in resistors and sensors, aiming to differentiate through customization and advanced technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 16.8 billion yen, with operating profit of 1.66 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 2.01 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in sales and profitability, with a strong equity ratio (83%) and a workforce of 1,729 employees. The growth trajectory is positive, with a focus on expanding into new markets and increasing R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Teikoku Tsushin Kogyo emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and customizable electronic components, leveraging proprietary technologies to meet diverse and advanced customer needs. Their unique value lies in their ability to provide integrated, space-efficient ICB modules, high-precision sensors, and flexible solutions for emerging applications in automotive, healthcare, and industrial sectors, with a strong commitment to sustainability and customer satisfaction.
